package.description: A prime number (or a prime) is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself. Prime Number Counter is a small utility to calculate the prime numbers.

en-US.description: A prime number (or a prime) is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself. Prime Number Counter is a small utility to calculate the prime numbers.
en-US.longDescription:
A prime number (or a prime) is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

Vovsoft Prime Number Counter is a small utility to calculate the prime numbers. You can make the software count up to a certain number or to infinity. Prime Number Counter displays last found prime number, total number of prime numbers and the elapsed time. You can click "Stop" button whenever you want the software to stop counting. You can also save the generated prime number list as a text file.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Prime Number Counter
